Dlvl:1 $:0 HP:39(39) Pw:2(2) AC:2 HD:8

comment: Independent uhitm.c hmonas() witness for gt.twohits. A debug Valkyrie wishes for a silver ring, puts it on, unwields, polymorphs into a hill giant (one AT_WEAP attack) and punches a lemure (S_IMP, a silver-hater) bare-handed. hmonas() zeroes gt.twohits, so hmon_hitmon() passes W_RINGR|W_RINGL to weapon.c special_dmgval() and the ring sears the demon.
